title: 2.8.2.2 dev BUG : COB is zero if bolus canceled
body:
I use the wizard, enter 40g carbs, it proposes the bolus and I "ok" it.

After 0.40 units, I cancel the bolus. Injection stops.

![IMG-20210826-WA0000](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/131013803-57ff7940-fd6a-47d2-bdb4-089503f7d1cb.jpg)

I start again the wizard in order to recalculate the missing units. The wizards thinks that there are zero COB.

![IMG-20210826-WA0001](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/131013863-49501957-433a-4e89-83a9-1b44ce20903f.jpg)

comments.body:
This also happened to me and then triggered a (wrong) double carbs input, which was countered with too high SMB.
As described: The Problem is that the COB value often updates minutes later after the carbohydrate input.
1. 48 g Carbs+ 4 IU Insulin (Calculator): Bolus abort
=> COB = 0, IOB = 0
2. repetition: 48 g COB+ 4 IU insulin (calculator): bolus successful
=> after a while: 96 g COB + 4 IOB => SMB reacts too strongly to any increase
